errata.locus: Note on Genre; §I.8; §III.7a (new); §III.9; Part II §§I–V; the Doctrine
errata.was: the break from the consensus re-derived as a testable proposal; the wonder-worker read as a man whose works outrun the name, with the Word as the reading's gloss; Sappho 31 set as a triangle of lover, beloved and rival; the doctrine's lineage without Philo
errata.now: Version 2.2 (#1764) reads from the standing of the Historical Logos (#1757), Revelation First (#1755) and the Tenth Muse (#1756). The wonder-worker is Philo's Logos, named and refused in Philo's terms and written as a man at the hedge. The veil is the cosmos the Logos wears, torn, and the temple behind it is the Apocalypse's. The seats of fragment 31 are the Tenth Muse's; the lineage follows the Historical Logos's stations.
errata.reason: At the author's word, 2026-11-12: 'we need to ground in the existing framework, and make sure we are not reinventing the break from consensus with every fresh reading.'
